BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current C2-3, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-F in the area bounded by:

              a line 175.0 feet north ofand parallel to West 26* Street, South Federal Street; West
              26^ Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South Federal Street

to those of a B2-5, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Narrative: The subject property is improved with a live-story vacant warehou.se building that has
an existing floor area of 51,547:2 square feet and no parking. The Applicant proposes to rezone
the subject property from a C2-3, Motor Vciiicle-Relalcd Commercial District to a B2-5,
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to convert the warehouse into a residential building with 34
residential dwelling units and 35 parking spaces to be located on the ground-floor. The new floor
area will be 57,617.6 square feet. The existing height of the building, 83.39 feet, will remain
unchanged.
